Register Patient.description: Creates a Patient in the Eswatini client registry.

Record Encounter.description: Creates an Encounter for a patient visit at a facility.

Record Observation.description: Creates an Observation such as an HIV viral load result.

Upload Visit As Transaction Bundle.description: Adds several resources to a bundle and uploads them in one transaction.

Map Values To A Value Set.description: Registers custom input-to-code mappings for an Eswatini value set.

Delete Resource.description: Deletes a resource by type and id.

Find Patient By Identifier.description: Searches the client registry for a patient by national PIN.

Get Recently Updated Patients.description: Lists patients updated since the last sync.

Read Patient.description: Reads a single Patient by id.

Find Facility By Code.description: Searches for an Organization (health facility) by its facility code.
